Exercise: Ball Leg Curl

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- knee_flexion
- hip_flexion

Primary Muscles:

- hamstrings

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- glutes

Equipment:

- exercise_ball

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- hamstring_strength
- glute_activation

Contraindications:

- condition: recent hamstring injury, reason: could exacerbate the injury
- condition: lower back pain, reason: may increase pressure on the lower back

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single-Leg Ball Leg Curl, instructions: ['Begin on the floor laying on your back with one foot on top of the ball.', 'Position the ball so that when your leg is extended, your ankle is on top of the ball. This will be your starting position.', 'Raise your hips off of the ground, keeping your weight on the shoulder blades and your feet.', 'Flex the knee of the leg with the ball, pulling the ball as close to you as you can, contracting the hamstrings.', 'After a brief pause, return to the starting position.']

Substitution Options:

- name: Seated Leg Curl Machine, equipment: leg curl machine

Instructions:

- Begin on the floor laying on your back with your feet on top of the ball.
- Position the ball so that when your legs are extended your ankles are on top of the ball. This will be your starting position.
- Raise your hips off of the ground, keeping your weight on the shoulder blades and your feet.
- Flex the knees, pulling the ball as close to you as you can, contracting the hamstrings.
- After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
